notes.eligible: Replace with the official register size published by the CEC (בעלי זכות בחירה) before 25.10. 7,340,000 is an approximate pre-election figure; reports range up to ~7.56M. Read every pass: an edit acts within a minute. From 25.10 the feed reports an error while this is still 7,340,000, and on the night it reports 'register exceeded' if the counted בזב passes it.
notes.ignore_columns: Election-night fix for an unexpected column in the 2026 file: header names to treat as metadata, e.g. ["סהכ"]. The reader already ignores any header that is not 1-4 Hebrew letters, a column that is mostly not numbers, and one extra numeric column that explains a sum mismatch; checks.ignored_columns in results.json lists what was dropped.
notes.column_aliases: Election-day fix for renamed headers: {"their name": "expected name"}, e.g. {"מס' קלפי": "קלפי"}. Read by both the results file (expb.csv) and the per-station turnout file (station_turnout_url). Expected: סמל ישוב, שם ישוב, קלפי (or מספר קלפי), בזב, מצביעים, פסולים, כשרים. The yod spellings סמל יישוב / שם יישוב and בעלי זכות בחירה are already accepted; the turnout reader also takes קוד ישוב, מס' קלפי, הצביעו, מספר מצביעים and אחוז הצבעה (with בזב).
notes.results_url: Same path as 2019–2022 (media2X.bechirot.gov.il/files/expb.csv). On 9.10.2026 it answered 404 to GitHub's runners while a third party saw a placeholder file from other networks (5.10): the files may not be up yet, or GitHub's cloud addresses may be blocked. Nothing is fetched from it before 27.10 22:00 Israel time; until then it is only probed (status.results_probe).
notes.drill_url: The 2022 file used by a rehearsal (falls back to data/official/k25_expb.csv).
notes.station_turnout_url: Set to the CEC per-station turnout file once its address is known. Status: chair's decision of 16.8.2026 (at least four publications per regular polling station); the High Court (בג״ץ 60697-08-26, 17.9.2026) vacated the plenum's 6.9 decision and left the ban on identified reporting; per Walla, JNS and Channel 12 (every four hours) the aggregate per-station publication stands. As of 9.10 no times, URL or format were published. A path in the repository (e.g. live_input/stations.csv, a copy the operator committed) is read the same way. Each new release (a new file) feeds the sector turnout and the Arab-society section; its time is sectors_time in live_input/turnout.json, set for every release (it labels only the file it was set for), else the time the file was first seen (22:00 if after the polls close). Comma, semicolon, tab or | separated; a blank, '-' or 0 figure is a station not reported yet.
notes.github_feed: Set to false to stop the GitHub Actions loop (it re-reads this file every pass) so a laptop or self-hosted run can take over without touching repository settings.
notes.publish_every_min: Branch mode (Pages deploys from main, the current setting): the feed commits site/live/ to main and asks Pages for a build at most once every this many minutes (1-60), because branch builds have a soft limit of 10 an hour and every push to main (the operator's too) is a build. The first results file and the first exit polls after 22:00 go out at once. status.json heartbeat_s follows it. Ignored in Actions mode (no build limit there).
notes.lean_during_voting: The 2022-vote-weighted turnout pace by bloc is published during voting hours only when true (pending the CEC legal adviser); after 22:00 always.
notes.projection_paused: Set to true to stop showing the projection (the count is still shown), e.g. if the CEC file looks inconsistent; pause_reason is shown on the page. Acts at the next pass on the last accepted file, even while the CEC file is unchanged or rejected.
notes.envelopes_expected: Valid votes expected in double envelopes. Set ONLY from an official CEC statement (acting DG Dean Livne reportedly expects 600–700k envelopes; 2022 had 462,807 voters, 458,714 valid); otherwise it is estimated from 2022 and the count is never marked complete. Acts at the next pass, like projection_paused.
